messages:
Marta P: Quick sync — cloud partner offered a small engineering grant to build a marketplace-ready IaC pack for their Ampere/NVIDIA partner HW. We need a plan for ref arch, terraform modules, and packaging. Thoughts?
Alex M: Awesome — timeline?
Marta P: They want a first draft in 3 weeks to align with partner webinar on Apr 14. Not flexible.
Julia L: I can own the Terraform module layout and tests. Propose modules: network, k8s-cluster, inference-pool (gpus), ops (logging/monitoring). Keep each module tiny and example-driven.
Sam G: I'll own CI + release pipeline (GitHub Actions -> Terraform Registry publish). Need naming convention: `redwood/partner-{cloud}-{component}` or `redwood/partner-{partner}-{component}`?
Ravi K: For marketplace packaging we need an architecture matrix: ARM vs x86, AMI/container variants, MIG+NVLink configs. I'll get partner image artifacts and map them.
Alex M: Also include model-cache pattern and S3 policy examples; we should show a secure KMS envelope flow.
Julia L: Yep. I'll add `model-cache` example and a `examples/` folder per platform (`examples/ampere-onprem`, `examples/graviton-cloud`).
Marta P: Legal/compliance requested a data-flow diagram and KMS guidance for the marketplace listing. Can someone draft a one-pager?
Sam G: I'll draft the KMS + least-priv infra policy doc and embed a sample `policy.json`.
CloudPartnerBot: deploy-checklist created: https://ci.internal/ci/1234 — will post CI status updates to this thread.
Ravi K: We need a smoke test harness that runs a tiny inference job to validate NVLink/MIG assignments. Suggest `ci/smoke.sh` that runs `curl` against the test endpoint and validates tokens and latency.
Alex M: Also, Platform asked autoscale configs be optional (default off). Document that in README and module variables.
Julia L: I'll push the initial module skeleton today. Plan: module inputs minimal, outputs documented, and `examples/` with a one-command bootstrap.
Marta P: Who will coordinate announcement copy + joint blog? Marketing wants technical bullets by next Tue.
Ravi K: I can draft the technical section for the joint blog and the partner-facing deployment guide. Marketing will handle the public copy.
Alex M: I'll add security notes: `kms_key`, `s3_encrypt`, `s3_block_public_policy` examples and a short snippet: `resource "aws_kms_key" "models" { description = "model cache key" }`.
Sam G: I'll add `publish-module.yml` workflow and a `smoke` job that runs on PRs to `examples/*`. Also add a tfsec job.
Julia L: PR incoming by EOD with the skeleton + `examples/ampere-onprem` and `examples/graviton-cloud`.
Marta P: Nice. Triage summary: Julia = tf modules & examples, Sam = CI & publish, Ravi = marketplace packaging/images & blog tech, Alex = security & model-cache patterns, Marta = PM + partner liaison. Weekly check-ins Tuesdays 10am PT.
Alex M: Noted. I'll open a tracking GH issue and assign owners + milestones.
Sam G: I'll create the GH Actions secrets doc and example `secrets.md` for partner onboarding.
Julia L: I'll include a `tests/` folder with `smoke.tf` and a minimal `test_infer.py` that hits the endpoint.
Marta P: Thanks all — I'll update the partner and send calendar invites. :rocket:
Alex M: +1, and please add the partner contact info in the GH issue so we can loop them into PR reviews.
Ravi K: I'll ping the partner for image urls and a small sample model to run in CI.
CloudPartnerBot: Reminder scheduled: weekly-sync Tuesdays 10:00 PT.
